title: Dragon and Lady in Vault
description: A green cartoon dragon wearing a red scarf sits inside a large circular metallic vault door embedded in a stone wall, surrounded by dark thorny vines. A woman in a flowing white dress sits on a blue chaise lounge to the right, holding a lit candelabra and gazing at the dragon, with a broken arched window behind her showing a desolate icy landscape at sunset.
prompt: A whimsical surreal scene shows a cute green cartoon dragon with blue eyes and a red scarf sitting inside an open circular metallic vault door set in a cracked stone wall, surrounded by dark thorny vines. To the right, an elegant woman in a long flowing white dress sits on a blue vintage chaise lounge, holding a lit candelabra with multiple candles. Behind her is a broken arched window revealing a desolate snowy landscape with bare trees under an orange sunset sky. Dramatic light beams down from above onto the dragon, dark smoky atmosphere surrounds the scene, detailed digital painting style.
